en:
My hair bristles with rage beneath my helm.
I lean on the rail; the pelting rain has stopped.
I raise my eyes, cry out to the sky,
my heart ablaze.
Thirty years of honours are dust and dirt,
eight thousand li of road, cloud and moon.
Do not idle, lest a young head turn white
and grieve in vain.
The shame of Jingkang is not yet avenged;
a subject's wrath - when will it be quenched?
I will drive my chariots
through the Helan passes!
Hungry, I'll feast on the invaders' flesh;
thirsty, I'll laugh and drink the Xiongnu's blood.
Let me start anew, win back our old lands
and bow before the throne!

Quanzhen Disciple: The Big Dipper Array is Quanzhen's mightiest art.

Quanzhen Disciple: Each of the Seven Masters teaches different arts.

Huashan Disciple: Martial skill only grows as you build up your own strength.

Disciple: Master's kung fu is amazing.

At the summit of Mt. Hua, the Eastern Heretic, Western Venom, Southern Emperor, Northern Beggar and Qiu Qianren are locked in a contest of internal energy.

Qiu Qianren, at odds with Guo Jing, challenges him to a duel; Guo Jing holds that a former Jin lackey has no right to the Contest of Mount Hua. Once Qiu is beaten, Hong Qigong and Huang Yaoshi both declare Guo Jing's kung fu the best in the world.
But Ouyang Feng refuses to accept it, and Guo Jing won't let him become the best in the world. You join the fight.
After a desperate battle, Ouyang Feng is beaten out of his wits and runs off babbling in Sanskrit.
Guo Jing: Thank you for your help. Take this Nine Yin Manual. Whether you can grasp its secrets is up to you.
Oh! So that's how it works. What a marvelous book!
The main story ends here. Thank you for supporting BOSS Studio! I've been busy with my college entrance exam, so the game isn't all it could be. Please bear with me!
